summary: Moving the computers changes what a librarian can see from the reference desk.
realLife: Greenville's interim policy rearranged connected computers so staff could see every station and removed the privacy screens.
inGame: needs: station layout before and after the change.

turns.pulledBy: A station is moved into the desk's sight line.
turns.what: Staff check the view from the ordinary work chair.
turns.writesBack: The floor plan reflects the move.

turns.pulledBy: A wall blocks the view from the desk.
turns.what: The manager identifies the blind spot at the meeting.
turns.writesBack: The board has to reconsider the layout.
